kicker: SCION 093 · FRAMING, GESTURE, CITY RHYTHMS & VIDEO ESSAYS
title: What Is Neorealism? — Counterfactual Cuts
subtitle: Testing tight plot-driven cuts against wide neorealist duration on the exact same archival source
theorem: Demonstrate an editorial theory by cutting the exact same underlying source footage two ways: first trimmed tightly to instrumental plot action, then re-played in its full wide duration so the street, waiting, and kitchen tissue remain intact.
boundary_note: Uses `reframe` and `split` modes on the same archival clip IDs (`d2156bef`, `46f3aa0c`, `a1f5bfaf`) to make the counterfactual edit falsifiable.

critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Directly compares tight instrumental crops against full neorealist environmental holds on `d2156bef` (1970 kitchen), `a1f5bfaf` (1938 street cafe), and `46f3aa0c` (1927 promenade).
